headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.25
summary: This release brings back the navigation bar position setting for the redesigned shell: the bar can sit at the top, bottom, left or right of the screen again. Left and right use a compact vertical rail that keeps every navigation function, and switching the placement immediately applies to all open pages.

items.text: Navigation bar position is back for the new shell design, now with four placements: top (default), bottom, left and right. Left and right get a vertical rail with the same tabs, news badge, account controls and theme toggle as the top bar; changing the placement in Settings → Personalization applies to every open page right away.
